channel.title: Eject Guard
channel.description: Ejects external disks before a meeting starts.

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
Disk images no longer show up in the disk list. An installer .dmg you opened was listed as a disk to guard, and stayed there after you ejected it. There is nothing to unplug, so the app now skips them, and forgets any it remembered the next time that image is opened.

Signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled. Requires macOS 14.
